name: io.github.michaelvrlaku1/powerday
title: Power Day Planner
description: View and manage Power Day Planner tasks and habits from your AI assistant.

tools.name: get_power_day
tools.description: Show the user's Power Day for one date: score, streak, Musts, habits, top tasks (up to 10), and tasks that are due or overdue. Use it when the user asks what is on their plan today or how today is going. It reads only; it changes nothing.

date.description: Date to show. Defaults to today. Allowed range: 30 days back to 7 days ahead.

tools.name: find_tasks
tools.description: Search the user's task list by words in the title, status and due date. Use it to find a task id before updating, completing or moving a task. Archived tasks are never returned. It reads only.

query.description: Words to match in the task title. Case-insensitive. The * character is not supported.

due_from.description: Earliest due date, inclusive. Within 730 days of today.

due_to.description: Latest due date, inclusive. Not before due_from.

include_undated.description: Include tasks with no due date. Ignored when due_from or due_to is set.

offset.description: Number of tasks to skip, for paging.

tools.name: get_progress
tools.description: Show the user's last seven days of Power Day points, their streak, and progress on the goals in their active plan. Use it when the user asks how their week or their goals are going. It reads only.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Add one task to the user's task list, optionally with a due date, time and priority. If an identical active task (same title and due date) already exists, nothing is created and the existing task is returned unchanged, so it is safe to retry. Call it once per task.

due_date.description: Optional due date. Omit for an undated task.

due_time.description: Optional due time, HH:MM 24-hour. Requires due_date.

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Change the title, details, due date, due time or priority of one active task. Replaces the previous values of the fields you send; fields you omit are left alone, except that clearing the due date also clears its time. Confirm the change with the user first. Does not complete, reopen, archive or delete tasks.

description.description: New details, or null to clear.

due_date.description: New due date (YYYY-MM-DD, today or tomorrow), or null to clear.

anyOf.description: A calendar date as YYYY-MM-DD, or the word today or tomorrow. Words are resolved in the user's own time zone.

due_time.description: New due time HH:MM 24-hour, or null to clear.

tools.name: set_task_status
tools.description: Mark one task completed, or reopen a completed task so it is active again. Nothing else about the task changes and the action can be reversed by calling it again. Does not archive or delete tasks.

status.description: completed to finish the task, active to reopen it.

tools.name: log_activity
tools.description: Record progress on one Must or habit from the user's plan for today or yesterday, then return the updated score. Check-off habits are marked done. Count and duration habits have the amount added to the day's total; two logs at the same time both count. It never lowers or undoes a value. Do not repeat a call after a timeout; check get_power_day first.

amount.description: Whole amount to add for count or duration habits (minutes for duration). Ignored for check-off habits.

tools.name: preview_task_move
tools.description: List the unfinished tasks due today or overdue (up to 50) that would move to a new due date, and return a short-lived preview token. Undated and future tasks are not included. Changes nothing. Show the list to the user and get a clear yes before calling apply_task_move.

to_date.description: New due date. Must be today or later and at most 365 days ahead.

tools.name: apply_task_move
tools.description: Change the due date of the tasks listed by preview_task_move. Requires the preview token, the same task ids and the same date. A task moves only if it is exactly as it was in the preview; tasks edited, completed or already on that date since are left alone and reported. Applying again moves nothing more.

task_ids.description: Exactly the task ids listed in the preview, in any order.

to_date.description: The to_date returned by the preview, as YYYY-MM-DD.
